objects.name: Analytic 1828
objects.description: For iOS, detect Non-Standard Port by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Protocol-to-port allowlist: HTTPS:443, HTTP:80, DNS:53, SMTP:587, IMAP:993, etc. Derive from enterprise network policy. Any TLS outside 443, 8443 (if approved) is non-standard.
Apps approved for non-standard port use (enterprise network tools, VoIP apps with custom ports). Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: empty — all non-standard port use flagged.
Default 300s. Sessions starting >5min after last user interaction with no foreground trigger are background-initiated.
